english.rec1.CONFIRMED: Confirmed in this node's verified history.
english.rec1.IN_LOCAL_MEMPOOL: Pending in this node's mempool. Not confirmed and not spendable.
english.rec1.NOT_OBSERVED_LOCALLY: Not seen by this node. The payment is not gone. Funds stay reserved and no automatic action is taken.
english.rec1.CONFLICTED: Conflicted with another transaction or an unavailable input. Reservations stay locked and nothing is released automatically.
english.rec1.REJECTED_BY_POLICY: Rejected by a recorded policy check. The payment record is unchanged and nothing is re-sent or released automatically.
english.rec1.BROADCAST_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN: Broadcast outcome is unknown. This version does not re-send.
english.rec1.CORRUPTED_EVIDENCE: This payment's record could not be verified. It is kept unchanged and isolated.
english.rec1.UNCLASSIFIED: This payment's broadcast state is not classified. Nothing is re-sent or released automatically.
english.errors.REC2_UNCERTAIN_RESUBMIT_DEFERRED: Uncertain re-submission is deferred in this version. The payment was not re-sent. Reserved inputs stay locked and are not released automatically.
